items.headline: Mixed Close as Inflation Data and Yield Concerns Vie for Investor Attention
items.summary: U.S. equities closed mixed on Wednesday. While better-than-expected August inflation data initially boosted sentiment, persistent concerns over high Treasury yields and a robust economy kept selling pressure on some sectors. The Dow Jones and S&P 500 declined, while the Nasdaq Composite edged higher. Not financial advice.

items.headline: August PCE Inflation Comes in Below Expectations
items.summary: The Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge, increased 0.3% in August, bringing the 12-month gain to 3.4%. This was lower than the 3.7% annual increase economists had expected, easing some pressure on the Fed for an October rate hike.

items.headline: Q2 GDP Revised Upward to 2.2%
items.summary: The U.S. economy grew at a solid 2.2% annual pace in the second quarter of 2026, an upward revision from the previous estimate of 1.5%. Consumer spending, a key driver, increased at a healthy 3.8% annual pace.

items.headline: Federal Reserve Finalizes Stress Test Rule Changes
items.summary: The Federal Reserve finalized two rules aimed at enhancing the transparency and public accountability of its stress tests for large banks, while also reducing volatility in capital buffer requirements. Changes will include annual public input on scenarios and averaging results from the two most recent annual tests for capital calculations, taking effect in 2028.

items.headline: Treasury Yields Remain Elevated, Weighing on Stocks
items.summary: Despite some easing in shorter-term yields due to inflation data, longer-term Treasury yields remained high. The 10-year Treasury yield rose to 5.30%, and the 30-year yield climbed to 5.64%, continuing to pressure stocks by making borrowing more expensive.

items.headline: Technology and Communication Services Lead, Consumer Staples and Financials Lag
items.summary: Information Technology emerged as the top-performing sector today, with Communication Services also showing strength. Conversely, Consumer Staples, Financials, and Consumer Discretionary lagged the broader market.

items.headline: Micron Technology Reports Q4 Earnings After Close
items.summary: Memory giant Micron Technology ($MU) is set to report its Q4 2026 earnings after the market close today. Analysts anticipate revenue of $51.069 billion and EPS of $31.61, following the company's prior guidance.
